messages:
Asha: FYI playbook automation is sending repeat onboarding nudges to accounts with health_score = NULL. noise spike and annoyed replies. temporarily pausing the run but we need a config fix.
Sam: can you get a quick count so we know scope?
Asha: ran a quick query, ~1.2k affected in last 30d (onboarding_state=in_progress AND health_score IS NULL).
Miguel: root cause: runner treat NULL as 0 in debounce logic. duplicates when score absent. suggest we add a sparsity gate and treat NULL as sparse.
Priya: also important: some pilots intentionally leave health_score blank until enablement survey returns. need a feedback_latch to opt those in.
Asha: proposal: add playbook rule fields: sparsity_gate (bool) + feedback_latch (account-level flag). semantics: if sparsity_gate=true and health_score IS NULL and feedback_latch!=true => skip. if feedback_latch=true allow.
Jules: can we auto-set feedback_latch from enablement webhook? what's valid signal?
Priya: yes. connector webhook includes survey_id and response_score. set feedback_latch=true when response_score IS NOT NULL. also plan a backfill: 3k accounts with responses but missing score. chunked update, rate-limit 5k/min.
playbook-bot: alert: playbook-runner: 2026-03-23T14:02:08Z 1234 nudges to accounts with null health_score (rule:onboarding_nudge_v3).
Sam: I'll put an emergency suppress rule to block nudges to health_score IS NULL immediately.
Miguel: I'll patch runner to respect sparsity_gate and add tests for NULL vs 0 vs numeric.
Jules: will run staging dry-run after patch: ./playbook-runner --env staging --dry-run --filter "health_score IS NULL" --limit 500 and report.
Asha: timeline: Sam suppress now, Miguel patch by EOD, Jules validate tomorrow AM, Priya webhook + backfill next sprint. Owners assigned. I'll update playbook docs with examples for sparsity_gate and feedback_latch.
Sam: suppress applied. ping me if any edge cases show up. :thumbsup:
